title: Chapter 313 The Origin Of The Bronze Palace
content:
Chapter 313 The Origin Of The Bronze Palace

Not far away from the ruins.

Lu Daosheng began to head in another direction.

He naturally just fooled Ye Wuwei.

As for why Ye Wuwei was so excited, it was just that Lu Daosheng added some stimulant to him.

However, the biggest opportunity he said was in the Bronze Palace, which is not a lie.

What he has to do now is to concentrate all the strong people in the ancient battlefield on the ancient battlefield.

And all this he did was for his uneasy daughter.

Thinking of what happened to his daughter not long ago, he felt unbearable.

Where did my daughter suffer such a crime?

But he couldn't take action.

Once he takes action, his daughter will probably be like this for the rest of her life.

"Xiaoxue, if you can survive this disaster in the ancient battlefield, then I can really feel at ease with my dad."

At the same time, several powerful forces in the entire ancient battlefield suddenly began to change directions and headed in one direction at the same time.

And there is exactly the direction of the bronze palace.

"Damn, isn't that Tang Hao?"

"What, it's Tang Hao!"

From a distance, Xiao Luo and Qin Feng and the others immediately saw Tang Hao coming towards him.

They never thought that this time the Tiandi Academy would be Tang Hao.

Could it be that the academy knew they were in trouble and sent to support them?

Thinking of this, the two of them felt moved.

At this time, Tang Hao also noticed the three of them.

"Huh? Who are you?"

"Senior Brother Tang, I am under Qin Feng, a disciple of Wang Hao, a Tianjian Peak."

"Xiao Luo, the disciples under Xiao Yin from Zhuyun Peak."

"Lu Xue, the disciples under Xiao Yin from Zhuyun Peak."

Tang Hao was slightly shocked when he heard the introductions of the three.

Xiao Yin!

In an instant, Tang Hao looked at the three of them with friendly eyes.

"In the lower Tang Hao, the disciple of Tan Songci of Langya Peak."

For a moment, Qin Feng, Xiao Luo and Tang Hao seemed to be the same as before at first sight, and they were almost excited to hug each other.

It was not until Lu Xue coughed lightly that the three of them separated.

"Senior Brother Tang Hao, how did you enter the ancient battlefield?"

Lu Xue asked at this time.

Seeing Lu Xue, Tang Hao couldn't help but be slightly stunned. He didn't look carefully just now, but now he felt a little moved when he saw him.

What a beautiful woman!

"This junior sister, that's how it is."

Immediately, Tang Hao told the story of the ancient battlefield appearing in the world, and then the academy called them together and entered the ancient battlefield under the leadership of Li Changqing.

When Lu Xue and his friends heard this, they immediately understood.

I see.

"Senior Brother Tang Hao, we found a treasure land in the ancient battlefield, which is highly likely to contain peerless treasures."

At this moment, Qin Feng suddenly spoke.

When Tang Hao and others heard this, they were immediately moved.

Who would not be moved by the treasure?

"Since you have discovered it, why don't you go by yourself?"

At this time, a disciple of the academy behind Tang Hao spoke.

Tang Hao also looked at Qin Feng with a smile.

He is not a fool. Even if he is from the same academy, he cannot be so selfless.

Everyone looked at Qin Feng.

Qin Feng spread his hands helplessly.

"My colleagues, let me tell you the truth. It's not that we don't go, but that there is a very powerful guy there guarding him, and we don't dare to go."

"Awesome guy?"

Tang Hao frowned slightly.

Qin Feng said indifferently: "The 19th place in the Monster List, the Gun God Chen Mingyu."

Chen Mingyu!

The court was shocked.

The six people behind Tang Hao looked solemn.

Obviously, he was very afraid of Chen Mingyu's strength.

But Tang Hao smiled in the crowd.

"Chen Mingyu is right, haha."

Tang Hao is not afraid of others when they are afraid of him.

Why? He ranks one higher than Chen Mingyu’s demon list.

Since he can be ahead of Chen Mingyu, it naturally makes sense.

"Junior Brother Qin Feng, where are you talking about? Hurry up and lead the way."

Tang Hao waved his hand casually, showing great disdain for Chen Mingyu.

However, Qin Feng said with a bitter face: "Senior Brother Tang Hao, you should be more cautious. That Chen Mingyu is too terrifying, and he doesn't take our Tiandi Academy seriously at all."

"And, and he also said,

"say what?"

Tang Hao suddenly looked a little gloomy.

At this moment, it was not only Tang Hao, but also the people of the Tiandi Academy behind Tang Hao.

Qin Feng glanced at Tang Hao carefully, as if he was afraid that the other party would be angry. He took a deep breath and then said, "He also said that the people in Tiandi Academy are all useless people, and he saw each one killing the other."

As soon as these words were spoken, a strong murderous intent continued to overflow from Tang Hao's body.

"Haha, hehe, okay, very good."

At this moment, Tang Hao's aura suddenly became extremely terrifying, as if an ancient ferocious beast had awakened.

A huge hostility kept gushing out.

This was the first time that everyone present had seen Tang Hao so angry.

"Junior Brother Qin Feng, please lead the way."

Tang Hao looked at Qin Feng and said gritting his teeth.

From his words, we can already tell how serious his murderous intent is.

Everyone didn't know that Tang Hao had already had some hatred with Chen Mingyu.

With Qin Feng's words, he was naturally very angry.

This time, Qin Feng stopped talking.

"Senior Brother Tang Hao, let's go here."

Seeing Qin Feng suppressed the excitement in his heart, leading the way for Tang Hao and others, Lu Xue for some reason suddenly thought of the story of the Japanese entering the village that his father told him when he was a child.

Taijun, I know a small path when I walk here. . .

"Sister Xue, let's follow us too. There will be a good show."

At this time, Xiao Luo also stepped forward and smiled.

Hearing this, Lu Xue nodded slightly and then followed silently.

But for some reason, she always felt that this trip would not be so smooth.

Inside the bronze palace.

Chen Mingyu, who was meditating, suddenly opened his eyes, and a fairy light suddenly flew out of his sharp pupils.

"I see."

Hearing the movement, the other four people hurriedly looked at Chen Mingyu.

"Brother, have you understood it?"

The four of them had a hint of surprise and disbelief in their eyes.

Although they can also understand something from the murals, the rest is obscure for them, and it is basically impossible to understand thoroughly.

But at this time, Chen Mingyu not only comprehended so quickly, but also seemed to have gained something.

Feeling the four gazes in unison, Chen Mingyu nodded slightly.

"This mural describes the origin of the bronze palace."

"What!"

When the four of them heard Chen Mingyu's words, they were shocked.

However, the next sentence once again impacted their cognition.

Chen Mingyu continued: "This entire bronze palace is a peerless treasure with both offense and defense, and it is also an extremely rare space treasure."

As soon as these words came out, the scene suddenly fell into solidification.

Chen Mingyu turned his head slightly and looked into the depths of the corridor. The next moment, under the eyes of the four people, Chen Mingyu slowly walked to a mural.

I saw a lifelike man on the mural, wearing a bronze mask, holding a bronze palace the size of a human head high.

And that bronze palace is exactly the one they are in.

"Big brother?"

The four finally turned back from the shock.

Chen Mingyu did not respond to them, but slowly closed his eyes, then reached out to touch the bronze palace above the mural in front of him.

As Chen Mingyu's eyes shone with a fairy light.

The next moment, the bronze palace on the mural suddenly began to tremble, as if it was coming alive.

Buzz —

Space cracked.

A space passage suddenly appeared in front of Chen Mingyu.

"Let's go."

Immediately, Chen Mingyu stepped in directly.

Behind them, the four of them looked at each other, no longer hesitated, and quickly followed Chen Mingyu's pace.
